propositions: Escaped import breakage in rebar subpackages and scripts/ modules are not caught by the current CI wheel-probe (only runs `import rebar`, entry-point --help, and JSON-resource walk).
scripts/ modules that depend on sys.path configuration (e.g., bare `import alert_dedup`) can be masked by other scripts' sys.path.insert calls when run in the same process.
A deterministic import-walk checker must walk all 451+ rebar.* modules and 58+ top-level scripts/*.py independently, collecting all failures without fail-fast, and report them with tracebacks.
Optional-dependency modules (fastapi, mcp extras) must be attempted but recorded as skip only when their declared dependency is confirmed absent; any other failure is a real regression.
The import-walk script must be portable (runnable locally without CI) and integrated into `.github/workflows/_artifact-probe.yml` with documentation in docs/releasing.md.
